entry.name: Mozilla Firefox
entry.verified: Firefox 156.0.dmg: SHA512SUMS.asc Good signature, Mozilla release key 14F26682D0916CDD81E37B6D61B7B526D98F0353, sha512 matches (dev machine and Mac); codesign --verify --deep --strict ok, Developer ID Application: Mozilla Corporation (43AQ936H96), notarized; geckodriver codesign ok, Developer ID Mozilla Corporation (43AQ936H96); no checksum published for the geckodriver tarball
entry.notes: copied out of the dmg (hdiutil attach -nobrowse, detached). Its own updater may update it in place. geckodriver rejects a Host header whose port differs from its --port, so forward with the same local and remote port.
